### Download

| | |
|---|---|
| **Windows 10/11 (64-bit)** | [TiroSetup.exe](https://github.com/Min3scon/tiro/releases/latest/download/TiroSetup.exe): checks your PC, picks the fastest setup and walks you through it. Already have Tiro 2.0.3 or newer? It updates itself. |
| **Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer), macOS 13+** | [Tiro-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/Min3scon/tiro/releases/latest/download/Tiro-mac-arm64.dmg): open it and drag Tiro to Applications. **Intel Macs aren't supported.** The first launch needs one extra step because Tiro isn't signed with a paid Apple ID: see [the README](https://github.com/Min3scon/tiro#mac-apple-silicon). |
| Portable Windows app | `Tiro-…-app-win64.zip` (plus `Tiro-…-gpu-runtime-win64.zip` for NVIDIA GPUs; the app's setup fetches it for you) |

The `…-win64-core.zip`, `…-win64-runtime.zip` and `…-win64-files.json` files are for Tiro's built-in updater.

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning ("Windows protected your PC") because Tiro isn't code-signed yet: click
**More info → Run anyway**. Full history: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Min3scon/tiro/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
